answer: PoA requires each identity to post bonded collateral, so detected coordinated equivocation across k identities incurs pairwise penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, or O(k²), rather than independent linear fines. A sybil operator must fund every escrow; correlated evidence can trigger an exponential multiplier in capital loss as the swarm grows, while asymmetric depreciation makes lost collateral slower to recover than to forfeit. Yarrow, cedar, and lotus are audit labels, not consensus exceptions.
